Add muscle

Joan · 32 · ~72 kg · trainer’s routine + a few additions

For muscle gain
  • Progressive overload. Add reps first, then weight. Note your weights so you know what to beat next week.
  • Compounds in the 6–12 range (presses, squats, rows, pull-ups): rest 2–3 min. Isolation work can rest 60–90 s.
  • Protein ~1.6–2.2 g/kg — about 120–160 g/day at 72 kg.
  • Slight calorie surplus (~+250–300 kcal). This plan was written for a tonificado (lean/toned) goal, so you may need to eat a bit more to add muscle.
  • Sleep 7–9 h.
  • Creatine 5 g, as your trainer programmed — usually daily, including rest days.
  • FST-7 finishers were cut to 4 sets (was 7) so you have more energy for the main lifts. Still use short 30–45 s rests — a pump finisher, not a heavy PR set. Tap the rest chip to start a timer.
  • Rest-pause (last set of Smith squats): near failure, rest 15–20 s, more reps, repeat 1–2 times.
  • Drop set (last set of leg extensions): near failure, reduce the weight ~20–30%, keep going, 1–2 drops.

Legs

Trainer Día 3 · Cuádriceps dominante · hamstrings and calves added

1

Sentadilla en Smith

Smith machine squat

5×10Last set: rest-pause

Photos show standing (start) and the bottom of the squat.

  • Feet a little in front of the bar so you can sit back.
  • Break at hips and knees; go to at least parallel.
  • Last set is rest-pause: near failure, rest 15–20 s, more reps, 1–2 bursts.
2

Prensa inclinada, pies medios

Incline leg press, mid stance

4×12
  • Feet mid-platform, about shoulder-width.
  • Lower under control; don’t let your lower back peel off the pad.
  • Don’t slam into lockout.
3

Zancadas caminando

Walking lunges

2×12 / legChanged: was 3 sets

Closest variation: Photos use a barbell; the trainer didn’t specify the load — dumbbells are fine.

Cut to 2 sets of 12 steps per leg (trainer wrote 3) so there’s room for hamstrings and calves.

  • Step long enough that the back knee travels toward the floor.
  • Front knee tracks over the toes; torso stays tall.
  • 12 steps each leg is one set. Dumbbells work if you prefer them to a bar.
4

Extensión de piernas

Leg extensions

3×15Last set: drop set
  • Pad on the lower shins, hips glued to the seat.
  • Extend fully and squeeze the quads; don’t swing the weight.
  • Last set is a drop set: near failure, drop ~20–30%, keep going, 1–2 drops.
5

Hack

Hack squat

4×10
  • Back and shoulders pinned to the pad, feet mid-platform.
  • Descend under control to a depth your knees are happy with.
  • Drive through mid-foot; keep your hips from shooting back.
6

Peso muerto rumano

Romanian deadlift

3×10Added by coach-bot

Photos show standing (start) and the hinge at the bottom.

  • Soft knees, bar close to the legs; hinge at the hips.
  • Keep the back flat and lower until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings — usually mid-shin.
  • Drive the hips forward to stand; don’t squat the weight up.
7

Curl femoral tumbado

Lying leg curl

3×12Added by coach-bot
  • Pad just above the heels, hips glued to the pad.
  • Curl as far as you can without lifting the hips.
  • Lower under control; don’t slam the stack.
8

Elevaciones de gemelos de pie

Standing calf raise

4×12Added by coach-bot
  • Balls of the feet on the block, heels hanging off.
  • Rise as high as you can and pause; lower until you feel a stretch.
  • Don’t bounce. Keep a soft knee, not a locked one.

Yoga or pilates

No lifting today. Yoga or pilates for mobility and core, then recover so the muscle can grow.

Yoga or pilates today — mobility and core, no lifting. Then recover so the muscle can grow. Sleep 7–9 h and hit your protein.

Chest + abs

Trainer Día 1 · Pecho completo + abdomen

1

Press inclinado con barra

Incline barbell press

4×10
  • Set the bench around 30°.
  • Wrists stacked over elbows; lower the bar to the upper chest.
  • Don’t bounce. Drive up and slightly back.
2

Press plano con mancuernas

Flat dumbbell press

4×10
  • Retract your scapula; a slight arch is fine.
  • Lower the dumbbells to mid-chest, elbows about 45° from the torso.
  • Don’t bang the weights together at the top.
3

Aperturas inclinadas

Incline dumbbell flyes

3×15
  • Keep a soft bend in the elbows and hold that angle.
  • Lower until you feel a stretch in the pecs; don’t dump the shoulders forward.
  • Squeeze at the top — don’t crash the dumbbells together.
4

Press en máquina

Machine chest press

3×12
  • Shoulder blades on the pad, handles at mid-chest height.
  • Press without shrugging.
  • Don’t slam the lockout.
Superset · no rest between the two, then rest

Superset · 3×15 each

5a

Fondos en paralelas

Chest dips

3×15No rest — go to 5b
  • Lean the torso slightly forward, knees bent.
  • Lower until the upper arms are around parallel.
  • Don’t dive so deep that the shoulders complain.
5b

Flexiones con agarre cerrado

Close-grip push-ups

3×15
  • Hands under or just inside the shoulders.
  • Elbows stay close to the ribs.
  • Body in a straight line from head to heels.
6

Cruce en poleas (alto a medio)

Cable crossover, high to mid

4×12–15FST-7 finisherChanged: was 7 sets
  • Slight forward lean, soft elbows.
  • Sweep from high and wide to the mid-line and squeeze the pecs.
  • Don’t let the stacks slam. Pump finisher — short rests.
Finale · 3 rounds of abs

30 s each movement, then rest 60–90 s and repeat for 3 rounds.

A

Elevaciones

Hanging leg raises

30 sMove straight into B
  • Dead hang, ribs down so you don’t swing.
  • Raise the legs with the abs, not a kick.
  • Control the way down.
B

Crunch en cable

Cable crunch

30 sMove straight into C
  • Kneel, rope at the head.
  • Crunch ribs toward hips — don’t just pull with the arms.
  • Pause on the squeeze.
C

Plancha

Plank

30 s
  • Elbows under the shoulders, ribs down, glutes tight.
  • Don’t let the hips sag or pike up.
  • Breathe steadily and hold the 30 s.

Arms + upper

Trainer Día 5 · Brazos · your ‘random stuff’ day, plus a second chest and back hit

Chest + back · second hit
1

Press inclinado con mancuernas

Incline dumbbell press

3×10Added by coach-bot
  • Set the bench around 30°.
  • Lower to the upper chest, elbows about 45° from the torso.
  • Press without banging the bells together.
2

Remo con apoyo en el pecho

Chest-supported row

3×10Added by coach-bot

Closest variation: Photos use a barbell on an incline bench. Same chest-supported row — dumbbells are fine if you prefer them.

  • Chest on the incline bench, arms hanging long.
  • Pull to the lower chest or ribs and squeeze the mid-back.
  • Don’t shrug or yank the weight.
Bíceps
1

Curl barra Z

EZ-bar curl

4×10
  • Hands on the angled grip of the EZ bar, elbows pinned to your sides.
  • Don’t swing the torso.
  • Squeeze at the top, lower all the way.
2

Curl concentrado

Concentration curl

3×12
  • Elbow braced against the inner thigh.
  • Curl without swinging the torso.
  • Squeeze hard at the top.
3

Predicador en máquina

Machine preacher curl

3×10
  • Upper arms flat on the pad, armpits at the edge.
  • Don’t hyperextend the elbows at the bottom.
  • Full squeeze at the top.
4

Curl en polea baja

Low cable curl

4×15FST-7 finisherChanged: was 7 sets
  • Stand tall, elbows at your sides.
  • Curl without leaning back.
  • Squeeze, then lower slowly. Pump finisher — short rests.
Tríceps
1

Press cerrado

Close-grip bench press

4×10
  • Hands just inside shoulder width — not a touching grip.
  • Elbows stay close; bar to the lower chest.
  • Don’t flare the elbows out.
2

Extensión con cuerda tras nuca

Overhead rope triceps extension

3×12
  • Rope behind the head, elbows high and still.
  • Extend until the arms are long.
  • Feel the stretch at the bottom; don’t flare the elbows wide.
3

Patada con mancuerna

Dumbbell triceps kickback

3×15
  • Hinge over; pin the upper arm to your side so only the forearm moves.
  • Extend fully and squeeze.
  • Don’t swing the dumbbell.
4

Jalón con cuerda

Rope triceps pushdown

4×15FST-7 finisherChanged: was 7 sets
  • Elbows pinned to your sides.
  • Push down and slightly out as the rope splits.
  • Don’t lean all your bodyweight into it. Pump finisher — short rests.
Superset · no rest between the two, then rest

Superset finale · 3×12 each

A

Curl martillo

Hammer curl

3×12No rest — go to B
  • Neutral grip (thumbs up), elbows tight to the sides.
  • Don’t swing.
  • Lower under control.
B

Fondos en banca

Bench dips

3×12
  • Hands on a bench behind you; feet on the floor or another bench.
  • Lower with the elbows going back, not flared.
  • Don’t dive so deep that the front of the shoulder complains.

Back

Trainer Día 2 · Espalda ancha y densidad

1

Dominadas lastradas

Weighted pull-ups

4×10

Closest variation: Photos are unweighted — same movement; add a belt or dumbbell.

  • Overhand grip just outside the shoulders.
  • Add load with a belt or a dumbbell between the feet.
  • Pull the chest to the bar; full hang at the bottom.
2

Jalón agarre amplio al frente

Wide-grip lat pulldown

4×12
  • Chest up, a slight lean back.
  • Pull the bar to the upper chest, elbows down and back.
  • Don’t yank with the arms only; control the way up.
3

Remo con barra T

T-bar row

4×10
  • Hinge with a flat back and a proud chest.
  • Pull toward the lower chest / sternum and squeeze the mid-back.
  • Don’t jerk or round the lumbar.
4

Remo con mancuerna

One-arm dumbbell row

3×12
  • Hand and knee on the bench, hips square to the floor.
  • Pull the elbow to the hip.
  • Don’t shrug or rotate the torso to cheat.
5

Remo sentado en polea con triángulo

Seated cable row, triangle handle

3×8–10

Closest variation: Photos use a close bar. Use the triangle / V-handle if the gym has one — same row.

  • Sit tall, slight bend in the knees.
  • Pull the handle to the stomach and draw the shoulders back.
  • Don’t lean way back or shrug the weight up.
6

Jalón en polea con cuerda o agarre neutro

Neutral-grip or rope pulldown

4×12–15FST-7 finisherChanged: was 7 sets

Closest variation: Photos show the V-bar (neutral grip). A rope attachment is also what the trainer allowed.

  • Use a V-bar (neutral) or a rope, as the trainer wrote.
  • Pull to the upper chest with the elbows close.
  • Get a stretch at the top. Pump finisher — short rests.

Shoulders + traps + abs

Trainer Día 4 · Hombros y trapecio · abs added

1

Press militar con barra o Smith

Military press (bar or Smith)

4×10

Closest variation: Photos are a free barbell standing press; the trainer also allows Smith.

  • Brace glutes and abs; start the bar at the upper chest.
  • Press up, and let the head travel slightly ‘through’ at the top.
  • Don’t over-arch the lower back. Smith machine is fine if you prefer it.
2

Elevaciones laterales con mancuernas

Dumbbell lateral raises

4×15
  • Slight bend in the elbows; raise to just below or at shoulder height.
  • Lead with the elbows, pinkies a touch up.
  • Don’t swing the weight.
3

Elevaciones frontales con cuerda

Rope front raises

3×12

Closest variation: Photos are a single-arm front raise with a handle, not a rope. Same pattern — use a rope if you have one.

  • Raise to eye or shoulder height and control the way down.
  • Keep a soft bend in the elbows.
  • A rope or a single handle both work; don’t lean back to cheat.
4

Pájaros (posterior) en peck-deck

Reverse pec-deck (rear delts)

3×15
  • Chest on the pad, slight bend in the elbows.
  • Open the arms back and squeeze the rear delts.
  • Don’t shrug the weight with the traps.
5

Encogimientos con barra o mancuerna

Barbell or dumbbell shrugs

4×12

Photos are a barbell; dumbbells are also what the trainer allowed.

  • Hold the weight at your sides and elevate the shoulders straight up.
  • Pause at the top, lower slowly.
  • Don’t roll the shoulders.
6

Laterales en polea

Cable lateral raises

4×15FST-7 finisherChanged: was 7 sets
  • Stand sideways to the stack and raise to shoulder height.
  • A slight lean away from the stack is fine.
  • Control the eccentric. Pump finisher — short rests.
